tasks.title: Thread reply attachments and inline images
hazards: The screen scripts share the two-core build2 slice with other agents, so wait on page state (locators, waitFor) and the hold and release helpers, never on elapsed time.

The thread rebuilds every message node on each store update, so thumbnails render from cache state and re-render on onReady; never mutate a returned node. Inline images are the riskiest surface in this plan: allowlist by the served Content-Type, cap at 10 MiB, never SVG, fall back on decode error, revoke every object URL. The screen script must prove a hostile SVG and an HTML-as-PNG stay chips with no CSP violation.

lensFocus.spec: This branch implements docs/plans/2026-11-03-operator-attachments.md for issue .scratch/vecnet/issues/20-operator-attachments.md. Check limits against the hub (16 per send, 25 MiB, 413 and 429 shapes), empty text with attachments, the idempotency signature including attachments in web compose, web reply and TUI, and that every chip state and refusal in the plan exists.
lensFocus.security: Attachment names, media types and bytes are hostile. Web: inline only png/jpeg/gif/webp by the served Content-Type, at most 10 MiB, never SVG, decode failure falls back to a chip, every object URL revoked, no HTML sink, CSP changed only by blob: in img-src, the bearer only in Authorization (never in a blob URL or a download link). TUI: names through Clean; :attach reads only the named file, never follows it into an upload of a directory.
lensFocus.tests: Check that screen scripts wait on state rather than time, kill their hub and browser, never bind 45752 or 49575, honour SHOTS_DIR, build fixtures at run time, and that each named test in the plan exists and fails without its fix.
